comment.body:
Owner authorization — FND-07 non-default source-ref promotion

I reviewed and merged PR #69 at head
1e5712e0ba3f931205d9b9be1d4a34e076ce1b87
(merge 4d0602542d3120024ec5974501624c96e5de48d4).

I authorize execution of the exact eleven-repository promotion plan at:
https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/1e5712e0ba3f931205d9b9be1d4a34e076ce1b87/plan/verification/source-baseline-restore/promotion-plan.json

The only source-fork destination authorized here is:
refs/heads/ambisgis/review/fnd-07-baseline-v4

Use only the repository IDs and proposed commit/tree identities in that
immutable plan. Before publishing each ref, verify its source-publication
evidence and workflow containment. This authorizes the specified public
source-ref publication where applicable rights are established; it is not
a representation that unresolved third-party rights have been cleared.
Hold any affected ref if its publication basis is unresolved, and report
the exact material and missing evidence. Continue independently safe
rows where possible.

I authorize disabling GitHub Actions at repository level on exactly those
eleven source forks before any promotion, and verifying the disabled
state. Leave Actions disabled afterward. Do not change Actions on
ambisgis-platform, any other repository, or at account/organization level.
Do not delete workflow files, weaken rulesets or install credentials.
If existing credentials cannot perform or verify this setting, identify
the exact repositories and UI actions I must complete.

Create only absent review refs. An already correct ref may be verified
and reused without writing. A ref at any other commit is a collision:
do not overwrite, advance or force it. Preserve existing branches, tags,
defaults and history. Do not change the approved commits to solve a
publication or workflow problem without another review.

I accept the source-restoration, notice-preservation and enumerated asset
evidence in PR #69 within its documented limits. That is not semantic
license clearance of every retained file, complete transitive toolchain
recovery, or final FND-07 acceptance before source delivery is verified.

This does NOT authorize creating/updating source-fork ambisgis/main,
changing default branches, merging source PRs, broad Git mirror pushes,
publishing custody archives/binaries/releases, enabling inherited
workflows, or production deployment. FND-02 remains accepted. FND-08,
final FND-07 acceptance and later distribution/security gates remain
separate.
